title: A smooth morphism admits lifts after an etale covering of a thickening of the target
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a smooth morphism of algebraic spaces and a thickening of the target, the lemma produces an etale covering of the thickening over which the given square admits a dotted arrow, rather than requiring a global lift. The proof passes to an etale chart of the thickening, applies the infinitesimal lifting criterion on the chart, and descends the resulting lift back along the covering. Descending the chartwise lift to the required covering statement is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 4735-4752.
